alternative_queries: Context-aware recommender systems for impression-time features such as tab, hour, and weekday: compare additive user/item scoring with factorization machines, field-aware factorization machines, and deep feature-interaction models for within-user ranking; address overfitting, temporal leakage prevention, fixed evaluation, and effects on GAUC and nDCG@5.

Feature-interaction architectures for recommender-system ranking using user, item, and request-context signals: literature comparing additive ID models, factorization machines, field-aware interactions, and Deep & Cross Networks, with emphasis on bounded changes, regularization, temporal leakage-safe training, and improvements in within-user GAUC and nDCG@5.

Context-gated and mixture-of-experts ranking models for recommendation impressions, including tab-, hour-, and weekday-conditioned user/item scoring: evaluate whether interactions beyond an additive scorer improve within-user ordering while preserving temporal causality, controlling overfitting, using only impression-time available features, and reporting GAUC and nDCG@5 under a fixed evaluation protocol.

Deep recommender architectures for categorical feature crosses and contextual ranking: compare factorization machines, field-aware factorization machines, Deep & Cross Networks, and context-gated or mixture-of-experts rankers against an additive user/video baseline using request context such as tab, hour, and weekday; focus on leakage-safe temporal features, bounded architecture modifications, overfitting controls, GAUC, and nDCG@5.
